facts.text: Founded in 1882 by Bishop Isaac Lane, a former slave, Lane College is one of the nation's oldest Historically Black Colleges and the first four-year institution established by the Christian Methodist Episcopal Church.

sources.title: Purpose Of College - Lane College
sources.quote: Founded in 1882 by Bishop Isaac Lane, a former slave, Lane College is proud to be one of the nation's oldest Historically Black Colleges, and the first four-year institution established by the Christian Methodist Episcopal Church.

facts.text: Lane College is one of only two private colleges or universities in West Tennessee with its own full-time radio station.
